modification_description: The deferred or cost-adjusted honoring must be made proportionate, credible, and procedurally legitimate rather than a vague deferral. Specifically: (1) confirm whether the promise is already earned and enforceable; (2) negotiate a specific replacement reward with a clear schedule and dated trigger tied to measurable milestones; (3) offer fair compensation or best feasible equivalent if deferral is not realistically achievable; and (4) seek appropriate internal governance approval (finance/board/HR) and communicate consistently to prevent the modification from being perceived as unilateral promise-breaking.
